set.body: Add value-bearing structures over a geometry: SurfaceField[A] for indexed vertex values, SurfaceMatrix[A] for vertices x features/time, SurfaceRoi[A], LabeledSurface, SurfaceSet, and HemispherePair. Acceptance: data/index lengths are checked, vertex ids are in range, SurfaceSet enforces shared hemisphere and vertex count, bilateral containers expose typed left/right access, and no plotting/color-map concerns enter these types. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/data, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface.
set.title: Surface fields, ROIs, sets, and bilateral containers
